plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero.
Sell SMH to reduce semiconductor risk.
Trim QQQI to 20% to lower income concentration.
Trim CRWD to 5% to reduce tech concentration.
Add SPY to 15% for broad market exposure.
Hold a significant cash buffer for capital preservation.
conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and concentrates on stable assets, aiming for low drawdowns. Expect slower growth compared to other modes.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to small percentages.
Trim MUU and SMH to reduce semiconductor concentration.
Trim QQQI to 25% to balance income and growth.
Buy XLV to add defensive sector exposure.
Maintain a moderate cash buffer for flexibility.
Focus on risk-first growth with blended assets.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets approximately 2.5% monthly return by managing risk first. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding some diversification. Expect moderate growth with controlled drawdowns.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce income concentration.
Trim SMH to 5% to manage semiconductor risk.
Add SOXL, SPAL, and MUU to increase leveraged ETF exposure.
Buy NOW, a top scanner setup, for concentrated growth.
Maintain a smaller cash buffer to maximize invested capital.
Embrace higher leverage and concentration for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% monthly return by leaning into leverage and concentration. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-conviction scanner setups. Expect higher potential upside but also substantially larger drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses due to leverage and ETF decay.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero.
Sell CRWD to remove high-beta tech exposure.
Add QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.
Add SPY to 30% for broad market exposure and potential dividends.
Maintain a cash buffer for stability.
Prioritize steady monthly distributions over capital appreciation.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% monthly return through steady distributions. It eliminates leverage and high-beta assets, shifting towards income-generating ETFs and broad market exposure. While prioritizing low drawdowns, NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
